questions.text: Low Energy: Over the last 2 weeks have you noticed reduced energy levels?

scale.label: No change; feel active all day
More tired after activity than previously
Decreased activity because of tiredness
Feel tired most of the time despite resting; decreased activity
Continually feeling exhausted; even small tasks such as brushing hair feels draining

questions.text: Paranoid Thinking: Over the last 2 weeks have you experienced paranoid thinking?

scale.label: No paranoid thinking
Increasing worry that others think badly of you
Suspicious that people at work or home think badly of you
Convinced that others have a low opinion of you and are trying to replace you
Convinced that others are actively planning to hurt you in many ways

questions.text: Irritability: Over the last 2 weeks have you felt more irritable?

scale.label: No irritability
Mild irritability
Increased irritable response to minor incidents
Anger expressed by 'snapping', verbal outbursts over minor incidents
Rage, major verbal outbursts over minor incidents

questions.text: Self Esteem: Over the last 2 weeks has your self-esteem been lowered?

scale.label: Good self-esteem or no change
Slight decrease in self-esteem
Poor self esteem with no reality base
Very poor self-esteem in all life-domains
No self-worth at all to the point of believing that the world would be better off without you

questions.text: Isolation: Over the last 2 weeks have you withdrawn socially?

scale.label: Socialise normally
Decreased socialising
Disinterested in socialising
Social and occupational withdrawal
Feeling isolated, 'in a bubble' even when with others

questions.text: Anxiety: Over the last 2 weeks have you experienced heightened levels of anxiety?

scale.label: No new anxiety
Increased anxiety when in public
Highly anxious when doing new tasks
Heightened anxiety when doing routine and familiar tasks
Panic attacks, highly anxious when doing ordinary and familiar tasks

questions.text: Somatic Symptoms: Over the last 2 weeks have you experienced physical symptoms?

scale.label: No physical symptoms
Increased muscle aches, joint pains on exercise
Increased back, leg and joint pains with little exertion
Frequent headaches, muscle and/or joint pains limiting activity
Severe aches and pains requiring pain relief and preventing activity

questions.text: Sleep Disturbance: Over the last 2 weeks have you experienced sleep disturbance?

scale.label: No sleep problems
Sleep broken by brief waking once or twice a night, but easily fall back to sleep
Sleep broken by waking several times a night, but easily fall back to sleep
Waking up three or more times per night due to hot flashes/sweating, plus difficulty returning to sleep
Sleeping two or less hours per night consistently; sweating/hot flashes interrupting sleep all night

questions.text: Weight: Have you gained weight (in comparison to pre-menopause weight)?

scale.label: No change in weight
Mild weight gain (1-2kg)
Moderate weight gain despite no change in diet or exercise (3-6kg)
Continuing weight gain and abdominal fat deposition, despite dietary restriction and increasing exercise
Major weight gain (>6kg) with abdominal, breast, hip and thigh fat deposition

questions.text: Sexual Interest: Over the last 2 weeks have you experienced a reduced libido?

scale.label: No change in libido
Mild decrease in libido
Diminished libido
Decreased libido and discomfort with sexual activity
Loss of interest in all sexual activity

questions.text: Memory: Over the last 2 weeks have you noticed any memory-related difficulties?

scale.label: No memory problems
Mild problems remembering names and numbers
Need to make lists to function at work and/or home
Impaired memory leading to dysfunction
Severe loss of memory leading to inability to function

questions.text: Concentration: Over the last 2 weeks have you experienced problems concentrating?

scale.label: No concentration difficulties
Mild problems with concentrating on reading
Mild problems with concentrating on reading and watching TV/Films
Marked problems with concentrating on reading and watching TV/Films
Unable to focus on any tasks
